entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this useless helmet I bought, and your online system is a joke. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Just look it up under my name! John Peterson. I bought this helmet about a month ago. The color is completely different from the picture, and I refuse to wear it. The box is still unopened, sitting right here.

Okay, Mr. Peterson. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet placed 40 days ago. I understand you're unhappy with the purchase. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, is the issue specifically with the color, or is there a technical fault with the item?

Are you listening? The color is hideous! That's the issue! I'm not going to argue about the safety or fit of a product from a company that can't even get its pictures right. This is unacceptable. Get me your manager.
I understand your frustration, sir, and I don't think a manager will be necessary. I can resolve this for you. One moment while I review our policy for this item.
You'd better. If I don't get a return label in my email in the next five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find.

Okay, I've confirmed the details. Since your helmet was delivered 40 days ago, it is well within our 90-day return window. I have just approved the return for you. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should receive it momentarily.
Fine. About time someone did their job. So I just print the label and send it back?

That's correct. Just attach the label to the shipping box and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Peterson?
No. Just make sure it gets done.
I will personally track it to ensure it's processed correctly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
